fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
An alert for each new order

The app sends you an email or Slack alert when an order comes in, with the pickup date and size on the first line. A reminder goes to the customer the day before pickup.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Call-backs for every nut allergy order

Hazelbrook Bakehouse bakes almond cakes on a shared bench, so its form never confirms a nut allergy order by itself. When Dev Raman ticks a tree nut allergy for a Saturday birthday cake, the order button becomes a call-back request. Owner Marisol Ybarra gets it by email and calls him before accepting.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { weddingCakes: "Build a wedding cake order form for my cake studio. Ask the couple for their guest count and suggest a cake size from my chart, like three tiers serving 150 for 140 guests. Price it at $6 a serving and show the quote before they book a tasting. Let them pick a flavor and filling for each tier.", birthdayCakes: "Build a birthday cake order form for my bakery. Customers choose a size and flavor, type the message to pipe on top with a 30 character limit, and upload a photo of the design they like. Put each order on a decorator ticket that shows the message exactly as typed, next to the photo.", allergyRequests: "Build a cake order form for my bakehouse. We bake almond cakes on the same bench as everything else, so if a customer ticks a tree nut allergy, replace the order button with a call-back request. Email me the request with their phone number, and keep the order unconfirmed until I call them.", deliveryOrders: "Build a cake order form for my cake shop with pickup or delivery. Delivery is $20 within 10 miles, plus $2 for each mile beyond 10. Ask for the venue address and its distance, add the delivery fee to the cake price, and show the total before the customer sends the order." };

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Dev Raman ticks a tree nut allergy on Hazelbrook Bakehouse's cake order form, so the order button becomes a call-back request and owner Marisol Ybarra gets an email to call him before accepting.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Before day one, the missing record is requested

Otis Beaumont-Kerr starts at Quill Hollow Preschool on Monday, Nov 2. His form came in complete except for the immunization record. On Oct 19, 14 days before his first day, the app emails his mother, Leah Beaumont-Kerr, a link to upload it to his file.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Visits left drop to 3, and her therapist gets an email

Once the call to the plan ends, the Tillbrook Physical Therapy front desk fills in the staff section for Sunniva Holt. She has a $30 copay, $250 of deductible left, and 17 of 20 visits used this year. With 3 visits left, the app emails her therapist, Imani Brooke, before another session goes on the calendar.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
At 3 p.m., Slack gets every unverified scan

Tomorrow's schedule at Pell Street Imaging has 24 scans, and 21 are verified. At 3 p.m. the app posts the other 3 to the #scheduling Slack channel. One is an MRI marked as needing prior authorization, with no authorization number on file yet, and a scheduler picks it up before the end of the day.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { dentalOffices: "My dental office sends every new patient an insurance form when they book. Ask for the plan name, member ID, group number, and the policyholder's name, plus photos of the front and back of the card. Save each patient's answers to a record and list it for the front desk as ready to verify.", physicalTherapy: "Our physical therapy clinic calls each patient's plan before the first visit. Give the front desk a staff section for the copay, deductible left, visits allowed this year, visits used, and the call reference number. When a patient has 3 visits left, email their therapist.", counseling: "Our counseling practice sees teens covered on a parent's plan. Ask whether the patient is the policyholder, and if the answer is no, open a section for the policyholder's name, date of birth, employer, and relationship to the client. End with a typed signature confirming the details.", imagingCenters: "I run scheduling at an imaging center. Track tomorrow's scans with a verified or open status, plus prior authorization status and number for each one. At 3 p.m. every day, post any scan that is still open to our #scheduling Slack channel, with what is missing." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an insurance verification form that saves every response to a database I own.

An email reminder the afternoon before

Every cook gets an email the afternoon before their date with the address, the drop-off window, and the family's food notes. Nobody has to dig back through a group text for them.

fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Nora's answers are in Owen's inbox before 8:30

Moraine Physical Therapy sends the intake link when a first evaluation is booked. Nora Haddad answers on her phone: right knee, pain at 6 of 10 on stairs, and a goal of climbing to her apartment without the rail. Before her 8:30 evaluation, physical therapist Owen Pryce gets an email card with those answers.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
The surgeon's protocol arrives with the referral

Pellwood Sports PT asks post-surgery patients for the surgery date and an upload of the surgeon's referral and protocol. Elena Brooks reports an ACL reconstruction on Oct 9 and attaches both files. Post-op lead Tess Okonkwo gets an email card with the protocol before she books the first visit.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { newEvaluations: "I run Moraine Physical Therapy. Build a PT intake form that goes out when a first evaluation is booked. Ask for the body region, a 0 to 10 pain rating, what makes the pain worse, and the one activity they want back. Before the evaluation, email the treating physical therapist a card with those answers, and save everything to the patient's record.", insuranceCards: "Build a new-patient form for Calder Physical Therapy that asks for a photo of the front of the insurance card. Read the member ID, group number, and plan name into fields. Any field read below 80% confidence goes to Ingrid Solberg at the front desk to confirm before the visit.", workInjuries: "My clinic is Osterman Rehab. Add a question to our intake asking where the injury happened. If they pick at work, ask for the employer, the claim number, and the adjuster's email, then send that intake to our billing coordinator, Wynn Mercado, instead of the insurance queue. Show today's intakes with where each one went.", postOpReferrals: "Build an intake for post-surgery patients at Pellwood Sports PT. Ask for the procedure, the surgery date, and uploads of the surgeon's referral and protocol. When both files are in, email our post-op lead, Tess Okonkwo, a card with the answers and the protocol attached, so she can book the first visit." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a pt intake form that saves every response to a database I own.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
The nurse is told of a severe allergy at once

Priya Halvorsen's form at Kestrel Ridge Middle School lists a severe peanut allergy and an epinephrine auto-injector kept in the nurse's office. Nurse Colette Amari gets an in-app alert when the form comes in, and Priya joins the grade 7 allergy list.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { newEnrollment: "Build a new student information form for Birch Hollow Elementary. Parents enter the student's name, grade, date of birth, and home address, plus 2 emergency contacts in calling order. Add directory opt-out checkboxes for photograph, address, and telephone listing, and show a Photo opt-out flag on the student's row in the roster the yearbook office uses.", addressChanges: "Build a change of information form for families at Birch Hollow Elementary. A parent picks their child, enters the new address and the date of the move, and submits. Update the student's row with the new address, keep the old address below it with the date it changed, and email the front office with both addresses.", schoolNurses: "Build the health section of the student information form for Kestrel Ridge Middle School. A yes to any allergy opens questions on the trigger, the severity, and any medication kept at school. When an allergy is marked severe, send the school nurse an in-app alert and add the student to an allergy list for their grade.", collegeRegistrars: "Build a release form for students at Fenwick State College. The student names the records to release, the purpose, and the person who may receive them, then signs on screen. Save each signed release to the student's record and show the registrar a queue of releases marked Signed or Waiting." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pick the answers that need a person to act, and a channel for each. A new address can email the front office, a severe allergy can alert the nurse in the app, and a counselor can get a Slack message.
